features.title: Mind over matter
features.text: Occult spells and enhanced psi cantrips express your conscious mind. Some choices favor burst damage; others emphasize protection, movement or mental tricks.

features.title: Amps and psyche
features.text: Spend focus points to amp psi cantrips. Unleash your psyche for a short surge of spell damage and special actions, followed by a recovery period with the stupefied condition.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4 → 3–5. Offensive conscious minds and unleashed spell damage can excel; utility-oriented minds invest elsewhere.
ratings.defense: 1 → 2. Limited armor and low HP require careful positioning and protective spells.
ratings.support: 4 → 3–4.5. Conscious mind and occult spell choices can emphasize control and party assistance.
ratings.utility: 3 → 3–4. Occult spells and mind-specific cantrips offer different exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Track amps, focus points, unleash timing and the recovery period.
